description: $0.09 via x402: raw event logs by contract address and/or indexed topics over a block range (eth_getLogs) — the indexing primitive. Defaults to a 25-block window and narrows automatically when a node refuses on result size, and every cap or narrowing that bit is named in the response instead of silently applied. Base, Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum, Polygon, Gnosis.
name: chain_event_logs
